decisionScope: Which revision a current page publishes where the wiki's automatic Redirect fixer account overwrote it. Stage 01 re-detects every case from zweig_revision, zweig_revision_actor_temp, zweig_slots and zweig_content and fails when detection and these decisions disagree.
rule: Walk back from page_latest over consecutive revisions of the actor 'Redirect fixer' to the last human revision. A delivered text there that is no redirect is restored (restore-human-revision). An absent revision or undelivered text leaves the case open (withhold-redirect-relation). A human redirect there is the fixer's ordinary double-redirect repair and no case. The raw originals stay unchanged.
provenance: decided by the main instance after delegation by the operator on 2026-09-23, revisable
